title: Dhruva Business Intelligence & Operations Dashboard
description: Comprehensive dashboard for business KPIs, system health, and operational metrics for Dhruva Platform

panels.title: Total API Requests
panels.description: 📊 **Business Impact**: Shows cumulative API calls across all services and customers. This metric directly correlates to revenue generation and platform adoption. Higher numbers indicate growing business success and customer engagement.

panels.title: Request Rate (req/min)
panels.description: ⚡ **Performance Monitor**: Real-time request velocity showing platform activity. This is your pulse metric - indicates current load, user engagement, and system capacity utilization. Critical for capacity planning and performance optimization.

panels.title: System Health Score
panels.description: 🎯 **SLA Guarantee**: Automated availability tracking that ensures service level agreements are met. This directly impacts customer satisfaction and contract compliance. Green = Happy customers, Red = Potential SLA violations.

panels.title: Revenue Impact (Errors)
panels.description: 💸 **Revenue Protection**: Tracks errors that could impact customer experience and revenue. Each error potentially represents lost business value. This metric helps prioritize technical fixes based on business impact.

panels.title: Service Usage Distribution
panels.description: 🎨 **Product Strategy**: Visual breakdown of which AI services (NMT, TTS, LLM, Pipeline) are most popular. Guides product development, resource allocation, and marketing focus. Helps identify your cash-cow services.

panels.title: Service Request Trends
panels.description: 📈 **Growth Analytics**: Time-series view of service adoption and usage patterns. Shows which services are growing, seasonal patterns, and helps predict future capacity needs. Essential for business forecasting and scaling decisions.

panels.title: Average Response Time
panels.description: 🏎️ **User Experience**: Tracks API response times including percentiles (95th, 99th). Directly impacts user satisfaction and competitive advantage. Shows not just average performance but worst-case scenarios that affect user experience.

panels.title: Error Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: 🚨 **Quality Assurance**: Identifies which API endpoints are experiencing issues. Enables proactive problem-solving before customers complain. Helps prioritize engineering resources on the most problematic areas.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (rate(telemetry_obsv_errors_total{customer=~"$customer", app=~"$app"}[5m])) / sum by (endpoint) (rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{customer=~"$customer", app=~"$app", endpoint!~"/metrics.*|/enterprise/metrics.*|/health.*|/enterprise/health.*"}[5m])) * 100

panels.title: LLM Tokens Processed
panels.description: 🤖 **AI Revenue Tracking**: Monitors Large Language Model token consumption - your high-value AI service. Each token represents computational cost and revenue potential. Critical for pricing strategies and capacity planning.

panels.title: TTS Characters Synthesized
panels.description: 🔊 **Voice AI Metrics**: Tracks Text-to-Speech processing volume by language and customer. Shows adoption of voice AI services and helps with language-specific capacity planning and localization strategies.

panels.title: NMT Characters Translated
panels.description: 🌐 **Translation Analytics**: Monitors Neural Machine Translation usage across language pairs. Shows global reach, identifies popular translation routes, and helps optimize language model deployment strategies.

panels.title: Customer Quota Usage - LLM
panels.description: ⚠️ **Quota Management**: Prevents service disruptions by monitoring LLM token quota usage. Red = Approaching limit, requires immediate attention. Essential for maintaining service quality and customer satisfaction.

panels.title: Customer Quota Usage - TTS
panels.description: 🎚️ **TTS Capacity Monitor**: Tracks Text-to-Speech quota consumption to prevent service interruptions. Enables proactive quota management and helps with capacity planning for voice AI services.

panels.title: Customer Quota Usage - NMT
panels.description: 🔄 **Translation Limits**: Monitors Neural Machine Translation quota usage. Prevents service cutoffs and helps maintain continuous translation services for global customers.

panels.title: System CPU Usage
panels.description: 🖥️ **Infrastructure Health**: Real-time CPU utilization monitoring. High CPU indicates heavy processing load or potential bottlenecks. Critical for performance optimization and scaling decisions.

panels.title: System Memory Usage
panels.description: 🧠 **Memory Monitoring**: Tracks RAM utilization across the platform. High memory usage can lead to performance degradation. Essential for capacity planning and preventing out-of-memory issues.

panels.title: Peak Throughput
panels.description: 🚀 **Capacity Showcase**: Displays maximum requests per minute the system can handle. Demonstrates platform scalability and helps with capacity planning and customer SLA negotiations.

panels.title: Active Services Count
panels.description: 🔧 **Service Inventory**: Shows total number of active AI services. Indicates platform complexity and helps with service management and resource allocation across different AI capabilities.

panels.title: Component Latency Analysis
panels.description: 🔬 **Performance Deep Dive**: Heatmap showing latency patterns across system components (database, model inference, etc.). Identifies performance bottlenecks and helps optimize the most critical components.

panels.title: SLA Compliance Overview
panels.description: 📋 **Contract Compliance**: Tracks Service Level Agreement adherence across customers and SLA types. Directly impacts customer contracts, renewals, and potential penalties. Green = Contract safe, Red = SLA breach risk.

panels.title: Service Availability Status
panels.description: 🎯 **Uptime Guarantee**: Tracks service availability against contracted uptime commitments. Essential for SLA compliance, penalty avoidance, and customer satisfaction. Shows real-time availability vs. contracted minimums (e.g., 99.9%, 99.99%).

panels.title: Response Time SLA
panels.description: ⚡ **Performance Contract**: Monitors actual response times against customer SLA commitments. Critical for maintaining service quality agreements and avoiding performance penalties. Green = Within SLA, Red = Breach risk.

panels.title: 💰 Revenue Stream Analysis
panels.description: 💰 **Business Intelligence**: Analyzes request patterns by service type to identify revenue opportunities. Tracks which services generate most activity, enabling data-driven pricing and resource allocation decisions. Higher activity = higher revenue potential.

panels.title: 🎯 Customer Satisfaction Score
panels.description: 😊 **Customer Experience**: Composite satisfaction score based on performance metrics, error rates, and response times. Critical KPI for customer retention, churn prevention, and contract renewals. Higher scores indicate better customer experience.

panels.title: 📈 Business Growth Indicator
panels.description: 📈 **Growth Metrics**: Tracks day-over-day percentage growth in API usage across the platform. Key metric for business expansion, customer adoption, and market penetration. Positive trends indicate healthy business growth.

panels.title: 🏆 Service Excellence Dashboard
panels.description: 🏆 **Executive Summary**: Comprehensive service performance table showing total requests, success rates, and performance metrics by service type. Perfect for executive reporting, customer meetings, and service quality assessments.

panels.title: 🌟 Platform Utilization Heatmap
panels.description: 🌟 **Usage Intelligence**: Visual heatmap showing service utilization patterns across customers and service types. Identifies peak usage times, popular services, and customer activity patterns for capacity planning and business strategy.

panels.title: ⚡ Real-time Performance Metrics
panels.description: ⚡ **Live Monitoring**: Real-time view of platform performance including request rates, CPU usage, and memory utilization. Critical for incident detection, capacity management, and immediate response to performance issues.

panels.title: 🎯 Customer Success & ROI Metrics
panels.description: 🎯 **Strategic Overview**: Section focused on customer success metrics, return on investment indicators, and business value demonstration for executive reporting and customer relationship management.

panels.title: 💎 Premium Service Usage Trends
panels.description: 💎 **Revenue Intelligence**: Tracks usage patterns of premium and high-value services. Essential for identifying upselling opportunities, optimizing premium service offerings, and maximizing revenue per customer.

panels.title: 🏅 Service Level Achievement
panels.description: 🏅 **Contract Performance**: Displays current SLA achievement levels across availability, response time, and throughput metrics. Critical for contract compliance, customer satisfaction, and penalty avoidance.
